# Orvio 0.12

- Orvio account: sign in or create an account with your e-mail. New accounts confirm their e-mail address first. Your account is in Settings > Account, where you can also sign out.
- The Home banner appears straight away, also when you come back to Home.
- Recently watched has a Clear button (films and series then start from the beginning again; favourites stay).
- Live TV, Movies and Series categories are in the same order as your provider lists them. Refresh the playlist once to apply it.
- Phone Live TV shows one cast button instead of two.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
